title: Machine Learning
description: This module examines machine learning algorithms and their applications. The course covers supervised and unsupervised learning methodologies, model evaluation techniques, and practical implementation strategies for solving computational problems.
learning_objectives: Explain the strengths and weaknesses of machine learning algorithms
Appraise the suitability of a machine learning algorithm to solve a given problem
Provide appropriate methodologies to evaluate machine learning algorithms
Implement algorithms to solve machine learning problems
Develop predictive models with machine learning algorithms
Apply unsupervised clustering algorithms based on machine learning
